name: Grace Santorini, Auberge Collection
insider_take: Perched on Santorini's dramatic cliffs, Grace Santorini offers front-row seats to the world's most famous sunset from the charming village of Imerovigli.
whats_special: This boutique gem sits in Imerovigli, known as the "balcony to the Aegean," offering unobstructed caldera views without Oia's crowds. The hotel's infinity pool appears to merge seamlessly with the azure Aegean Sea, while the property's minimalist Cycladic architecture perfectly frames the volcanic landscape. Grace Santorini is built into the cliff face itself, with some suites featuring private terraces carved directly into the volcanic rock.
pro_tip: Book a caldera-view suite on the hotel's western side - you'll have an uninterrupted view of the sunset without leaving your terrace, and Imerovigli's elevated position actually offers better panoramic views than the more famous Oia.
dont_miss: The short walk to Skaros Rock, a medieval fortress remnant offering 360-degree views of the island. Also, the hotel's champagne lounge serves sunset cocktails with a backdrop that's consistently rated among the world's most romantic. The nearby Blue Dome Church, one of Santorini's most photographed landmarks, is just a 5-minute stroll away.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Aegean Sea views
Sophisticated minimalist design blending luxury with Cycladic architecture
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Award-winning infinity pool with dramatic sunset views
cons: Limited accessibility due to clifftop terrain and steps
